item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path
for name in ['logo.svg', 'mark.svg']:
 p=Path(name);root=ET.parse(p).getroot()
 assert root.get('viewBox')
 assert not list(root.iter('{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}text'))
 assert not list(root.iter('{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}image'))
 assert root.find('{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}title') is not None
 print(f'{name}: valid SVG, outlined vectors, {p.stat().st_size:,} bytes')
print('Workspace files:', ', '.join(p.name for p in Path('.').iterdir() if p.is_file()))
PY"
